kevin_sales: Customer wants an Azure ExpressRoute POC to our Private deploy. They need DMZ TLS inspection and want to keep original client IPs for telemetry. Any pragmatic architectures? :wave:

maya_net: Two pragmatic choices: 1) Edge firewall terminate+inspect -> re-encrypt -> route to internal proxy that preserves XFF/mTLS mapping. 2) Bypass TLS inspect (passthrough) and add app-side header propagation. Tradeoff: inspection vs honest client IPs.

igor_sec: Security checklist request: provide our FQDNs/IPs, cipher/TLS versions supported, mTLS capability, and what logs we can share. If they insist on MITM at firewall, we need confirmation they control cert distribution and pinning exceptions.

vivian_ops: Quick pricing hints for a 2-week POC (~50-200GB): ExpressRoute egress negligible on-prem -> cloud, but Azure Firewall SKU + data processing can add a few hundred dollars for throughput-tested POCs. PrivateLink interface endpoints cost small hourly + per-GB processing; NVA/proxy EC2 equivalents add compute costs. Recommend PrivateLink for fastest setup unless orig IP must be seen.

maya_net: If preserving source IP is mandatory: run a spoke-side proxy that forwards original IP in X-Forwarded-For, or use NLB/NVA flows that support proxy-protocol so the target sees client IP. With Azure Private Endpoint you generally lose host IP to the endpoint ENI.

kevin_sales: Can we give them a one-pager with sample NSG/firewall entries they can paste into their security form?

vivian_ops: Paste this minimal set: 
- Allow TCP/443 to private.redwood.example (we'll provide CIDR/IPs)
- Allow DNS (UDP/TCP 53) between spoke and resolver if doing PrivateLink DNS override
- Allow NTP (UDP 123)
- Management (SSH/RDP) only from approved jump hosts
Also add MTU verification step when ExpressRoute + VPN coexist.

igor_sec: For the questionnaire snippet use: 
- Transport: TLS 1.2+ (TLS1.3 preferred); mTLS supported for Private deployments
- Key mgmt: customer-managed keys supported; integration with HSM possible
- Logging: token counts and request metadata available for Dedicated/Private; payload logs only under contract
- Incident: we provide timeline and IOCs on request under NDA

ops-bot: Task created POC-6110: attach connectivity checklist + sample NSG rules; assignee: vivian_ops

kevin_sales: Thanks all 64f I'll send the doc and schedule a 30m technical handoff. Can someone sketch a tiny diagram for the exec summary?

maya_net: I'll sketch two variants (firewall MITM -> re-encrypt -> internal proxy, and private endpoint with proxy-header approach) and share a PNG.
